## Hypothesis

Extending the holding period to 3DTE (from the 2DTE maximum tested in WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE) will capture additional edge by reducing theta decay further while maintaining the same directional signal (ITM-2, -8%/+30% exits). J's live 745P trade on 4/29 was 3 DTE, suggesting the edge may persist or increase at this horizon.

## Mechanism

Same as WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE: trigger on `vwap_continuation` signal (ITM-2, -8% stop, +30% TP1), but hold for 3 calendar days instead of exiting intraday. Uses same entry/contract selection rules. Exit logic unchanged: TP1 at +50% (sell 2/3), runner trails via chandelier profit-lock or exits on ribbon re-entry/time stop.

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ~= 14% headline P&L (per OP-20 disclosure #1). 3DTE premium ~2.5× 0DTE ITM2, so max contracts reduced accordingly.
2. **Sample bias:** Using J's 3 anchor days (4/29,5/01,5/04) for OP-16 edge_capture measurement risks overfit; these days represent <1% of 16-month sample. Selection method: immutable source-of-truth per OP-16.
